appearances.snippet: He's a senior productions director. Marcus Wada is the director of strategy of productions at Turning Point USA. ... Marcus worked to raise financing for films and producing films. He left Hollywood to work in the conservative movement producing and directing Turning Point USA's documentary series Border Battle and the great global reset.

verification.notes: The current TPUSA team page identifies Marcus Wada as senior productions director, and a bio sourced to TPUSA records his film and television background and production of Border Battle and The Great Global Reset.
